title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock II
description:
You are given an integer array `prices` where `prices[i]` is the price of a given stock on the `i`-th day.

On each day, you may decide to buy and/or sell the stock. You can hold at most one share of the stock at any time, and you may sell a share and immediately buy again on the same day.

Find and return the maximum total profit you can achieve.
hints: Because there is no transaction fee or limit on the number of trades, any upward climb from day i to day j has the exact same profit as summing every positive day-to-day increase along the way.
Whenever prices[i] > prices[i - 1], capture the difference prices[i] - prices[i - 1].
Sum all positive consecutive differences in a single pass for O(n) time and O(1) space.

examples.explanation: Buy on day 1 (price = 1) and sell on day 2 (price = 5) for profit 4; then buy on day 3 (price = 3) and sell on day 4 (price = 6) for profit 3. Total profit = 7.
Buy on day 0 (price = 1) and sell on day 4 (price = 5) for total profit 4.
Prices never increase, so no profitable transaction exists and the maximum profit is 0.
